## Security review
- Reviewed: 3f9c2ab41d0e8c7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b
- SEC-1 · dismissed — reset token logged at info — lib/login.rb / Login#reset — operator: the log is local to the dev host
- SEC-2 · open — factor code compared with ==, not in constant time — src/login.py / check_factor — cryptography · medium · exploit: a timing probe recovers the code a digit at a time
